findings.claim: T133-HYBRID: guard/reset updates are first-class non-smooth typed update semantics.
findings.failure_mode: The admission predicate admits guard/reset only when guardObserved=true, but the same formal section proves hybrid_no_guard_uses_update and the finite model accepts FM-T133-HYBRID-NO-GUARD-STEP-POS while computed_operator_admission.route_admitted=false. This splits executable hybrid semantics from operator admission: the false-guard branch is treated as a valid update by the theorem/runner but is not an admitted operator route.
findings.required_repair: Unify the hybrid admission semantics: either split guard/reset into trigger and pass-through update routes, or extend operatorAdmitted with an explicitly typed/admissible false-guard step branch. Then require every ACCEPT T133-HYBRID finite row to have computed_operator_admission.route_admitted=true, and add negative controls for false-guard step typing/admissibility failures.

findings.claim: T133-HYBRID: no differentiability or ODE-solution theorem is promoted; chart-labelled flow-one notation is only a declared chart/domain/local-law record.
findings.failure_mode: The formal API still defines SmoothChart.derivative and derivativeAvailable as mere chart presence, while finite T133-HYBRID smooth-chart positive cases accept derivative_requested=true. A chart token plus arbitrary derivative field is enough to make derivativeAvailable=true, with no differentiability, vector-field, smoothness, flow law, or ODE obligation. This is a hidden differentiability-admission claim despite the textual demotion.
findings.required_repair: Remove or rename derivativeAvailable/derivativeRequested for v12 to chartRecordPresent/flowNotationRequested, require derivativeRequested=false in all no-ODE release checks, or add explicit mathematical obligations for differentiability/vector-field/flow semantics before any derivative-positive case can be accepted.

findings.claim: OC133-NOSEND-001 and package-level release gate: public release remains blocked until fresh G57/G58/G70 Cerberus review plus owner approval and explicit manifest/channel unlocks.
findings.failure_mode: hypothetical_owner_approved_control returns ALLOW_AFTER_OWNER_APPROVAL when owner_approved, global_no_send_lock=false, publish_allowed, journal_submissions_allowed, and requested channel flags are true. It does not model the ledger's fresh_cerberus_required_for_release / G57-G58-G70 gate, yet FINITE_MODEL_CHECKS promotes this allow branch as the negative control for no-send.
findings.required_repair: Add explicit fresh-review gate fields to the no-send state machine and finite rows, require G57/G58/G70 pass states before ALLOW_AFTER_OWNER_APPROVAL, and change the current hypothetical allow control to REJECT_PUBLIC_ACTION unless those fresh-review fields are present and true.
